He was reliable and transmitted many hadiths, though those who transmitted from him did not qualify as proof.

Al-Nasāʾī counted him among the jurists of the Medinan Successors.
وكان ثقة كثير العلم والحديث وليس يروي عنه من يحتج به
He was reliable, had extensive knowledge and transmitted many hadiths, though those who transmitted from him did not qualify as proof.
